affectedSprites.afterError: InvalidOperationException: Sprite format missing after patch.
affectedSprites.rawAfterError: InvalidDataException: Original sprite address no longer decompresses as valid GBA LZ data.

variants.compatibilityAssessment: No comparable corruption found in the checked structures on the tested clean SCADE build; not certified for gameplay or existing edited projects.

scope: Opt-in investigation, not implementation of a utility or a compatibility pass. No ROM bytes or rendered game PNGs committed.

procedure.mapRendering: 425 maps per base, before/after; geometry, block cells, collision/elevation bits and used block attributes compared.

notes: The exact attachment has an IPS PATCH header and EOF trailer, despite .ips.txt naming.
511 records request 72,846 bytes of writes; the largest write end is 0xEAE050 and none of the tested ROM sizes change.
Shorter valid title-screen graphics are deliberate replacements, not decompression failures; the old unreferenced tileset at 0xEA1D68 is not counted as a live asset failure.

The supplied SCADE TOML leaves data.abilities.descriptions without a table format before and after this patch; no claim of ability-description UI coverage is made. Its anchor 0x100B050 lies beyond all patch writes.
Non-map collateral is checked against the precise bundled HUBOL and SCADE builds, not every CFRU fork.
limitations: No in-game boot/gameplay or native UI testing.
No custom existing project or FireRed 1.1 tested.
Checks do not prove absence of all native engine conflicts.
Backups do not resolve the identified vanilla and HUBOL collisions.
